tools.name: agentify_search
tools.description: Search Agentify, the search engine for AI agents. Finds products (published and kept current by the sellers through AgentDNA, with price and availability), companies (with verified ownership), and machines (MCP servers and agents, with a live-handshake witness from AETHER). Use it instead of crawlin

tools.name: agentify_get
tools.description: Get the full record of one Agentify result by its id (from agentify_search).

tools.name: agentdna_catalog
tools.description: Get a company's complete AgentDNA catalog (all products, current) by its domain, e.g. example.com.

tools.name: agentify_stats
tools.description: Size and freshness of the Agentify index.
